column1: # Reference Cas9 seeds for the homolog search.
# `source` is uniprot or ncbi. Most seeds resolve from UniProtKB; ThermoCas9
# is not in UniProtKB (the Geobacillus thermodenitrificans T12 strain is
# GenBank/RefSeq-only) so it is fetched from NCBI protein instead.
# `accession` is filled in only where it has been verified. Where it is blank,
# 01_collect_seeds.py resolves the entry with `query` and records the accession
# it actually found, so nothing in this table is guessed. Verified accessions
# below were confirmed on 2026-10-19 against the published sequence lengths.
# cas9_type follows type II subtype nomenclature. `role` marks sequences used
# as controls at evaluation time; whether the thermophilic ones are held out of
# training is set by split.holdout_positive_controls in configs/data.yaml.
# name
SpCas9
SaCas9
GeoCas9
ThermoCas9
NmeCas9
CjCas9
St1Cas9
FnCas9
